items.source_en:
- Use a Stilt-Type Solar Dryer: Dry seaweed above the ground to avoid contamination and maintain quality. Keep it off the ground.

- Spread Evenly: Spread seaweed evenly during drying for quicker and better drying. Do not cover seaweed directly to prevent condensation and overheating.

- Nighttime Coverage: Cover seaweed with raised plastic or tarpaulin at night to prevent condensation and allow air circulation.

- Rainy Day Protection: Use raised plastic covers during rain to keep seaweed dry and maintain its quality by preventing freshwater contact.

Important Notes:

Seaweed will dry (on average) in 3 days under full sunlight and 5 days with overcast skies or occasional rain. Check stations for notes on timing. We cannot afford to lose product.

items.source_en:
The passive Vortex Phantoms appear to have limited awareness of their surroundings. We've witnessed them acknowledge their aggressive kind, but when it comes to those of us who are unaffected, communicating with them has proven futile. 

The aggressive Phantoms, however, seem to have no issues locating us although some are more aware than others. We are unsure why a difference even exists.

Both passive and aggressive Phantoms appear to have issues interacting with their surroundings, but to what extent still remains to be seen.
items.legacy_ko:
소극적인 볼텍스 유령은 주변 환경을 제한적으로만 인식할 수 있는 것으로 보인다. 그런 유령들이 공격적인 유령을 알아보는 것을 목격했지만, 우리처럼 영향을 받지 않은 사람들과는 의사 소통이 전혀 통하지 않는다는 것이 밝혀졌다.

하지만 공격적인 유령들은 우리를 찾아내는 데 전혀 문제가 없는 것 같고, 어떤 유령들은 다른 유령들보다 우리를 더 잘 찾아내는 것 같다. 어째서 이런 차이가 존재하는지도 확실히 알 수 없다.

소극적인 유령과 공격적인 유령 모두 주변 환경과 상호 작용하는 데는 문제가 있는 것으로 보이지만, 그 문제가 어느 정도인지는 지켜봐야 한다.
